sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: When you are throwing a ball with your right hand, which foot should you step forward with?
options: A) Right foot
B) Left foot
C) Both feet together
D) Do not step at all

questions.question_text: What is the correct hand position to catch a ball that is coming towards your face or chest?
options: A) Palms facing the ground
B) Fingers pointing down
C) Thumbs together making a W-shape
D) One hand behind your back
questions.answer: C) Thumbs together making a W-shape

questions.question_text: Which part of your foot is best for making a short, accurate pass in soccer?
options: A) The toe
B) The heel
C) The inside of the foot
D) The bottom of the shoe
questions.answer: C) The inside of the foot

questions.question_text: What piece of equipment is essential for playing a game of Badminton?
options: A) A heavy leather ball
B) A shuttlecock and racket
C) A wooden bat
D) A basketball hoop

questions.question_text: When practicing 'Little Steps' or running fast, how should your arms move?
options: A) Straight up and down in the air
B) Crossed over your chest
C) Swinging back and forth from the shoulders
D) Hanging loosely at your sides
questions.answer: C) Swinging back and forth from the shoulders

questions.question_text: What does the phrase 'tracking the ball' mean in sports?
options: A) Running away from the ball
B) Keeping your eyes fixed on the ball as it moves
C) Hiding the ball from others
D) Drawing a line on the ball
questions.answer: B) Keeping your eyes fixed on the ball as it moves

questions.question_text: What is the most important thing to do before participating in jumping, kicking, or running activities?
options: A) Drink cold water rapidly
B) Sit down and rest
C) Perform a proper warm-up to prepare the muscles
D) Take off your shoes
questions.answer: C) Perform a proper warm-up to prepare the muscles

questions.question_text: If a ball is rolling along the ground towards you, how should you position your legs to receive it safely?
options: A) Stand completely straight and stiff
B) Jump up high in the air
C) Bend your knees slightly to lower your body
D) Turn your back to the ball
questions.answer: C) Bend your knees slightly to lower your body

questions.question_text: Which action shows the correct way to strike a falling shuttlecock?
options: A) Closing your eyes and swinging blindly
B) Watching it fall and swinging the racket upward or forward
C) Throwing the racket at the shuttlecock
D) Kicking it with your foot
questions.answer: B) Watching it fall and swinging the racket upward or forward

questions.question_text: Why do we use 'Little Steps' when changing direction during a run?
options: A) To maintain balance and stop quickly
B) To make more noise on the ground
C) To jump higher
D) Because it is a rule in all games
questions.answer: A) To maintain balance and stop quickly

questions.question_text: Explain the correct hand position for catching a ball that is arriving below your waist. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: To catch a low ball safely, keep your pinky fingers together with your palms facing forward to form a basket shape, bending your knees to reach it.

questions.question_text: Why is it important to step with your opposite foot when throwing a ball? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Stepping with the opposite foot provides better balance for your body and allows you to use your core muscles to throw the ball with much more power.

questions.question_text: Describe how to properly and safely stop a fast-rolling soccer ball. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Keep your eyes on the ball, move your body directly in its path, and use the soft inside part of your foot to cushion and stop its movement.

questions.question_text: What is the proper way to hold a badminton racket to strike a shuttlecock effectively? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Hold the racket handle gently but firmly, as if you are shaking hands with it. Keep your wrist flexible so you can swing and strike the shuttlecock easily.

questions.question_text: How should your posture be while performing 'Little Steps' or jogging in a straight line? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Keep your back straight, head up looking forward, and swing your arms naturally from front to back while landing softly on the balls of your feet.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are getting ready to hit a badminton shuttlecock that is falling from high up in the air. Describe your body's actions to hit it. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I would keep my eyes focused completely on the falling shuttlecock. I would quickly position myself slightly behind it, raise my racket high up with my arm bent, and swing it forward quickly to strike the shuttlecock forcefully over the net.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are running a short relay race and need to pass the baton to a teammate. Describe how you will move and pass it. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I would sprint as fast as possible using quick steps while pumping my arms. As I get close, I would firmly hold the baton out with my right hand and place it safely into my teammate's waiting hand without slowing down.

questions.question_text: Explain the complete sequence of physical actions for kicking a ball towards a specific target. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: First, look directly at your target to aim. Run up to the ball and plant your non-kicking foot beside it for balance. Swing your kicking leg back, then bring it forward to strike the middle of the ball with the inside of your foot, following through with your leg towards the target.

questions.question_text: Describe a fun motor-skill game you can play with your friends to improve your throwing and catching skills together. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: We can play 'Piggy in the Middle'. Two players stand far apart and try to throw a soft ball back and forth to each other. A third player stands in the middle and tries to jump or reach up to intercept and catch the ball. This improves both throwing accuracy and catching reflexes.
